# Enigma

Enigma provides comprehensive data on U.S. businesses, offering insights into their identity and financial health to support sales, marketing, risk assessment, and compliance processes.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/enigma/.

## Actions

- **KYB Business Verification** (read-only): This tool performs a know your business (kyb) check on a business by querying enigma's dataset of legal entities based on official state…
- **Screen Against Sanctions and Watchlists** (read-only): A tool to screen customers and transactions against sanctions and other watchlists.
